meta.title: SAP MDG (Master Data Governance): vendor changed in SAP MDG
gaps: Configure or verify SAP MDG integration INT-001 and its OAuth, endpoint, client_id, sync_mode, and batch_size settings
Configure or verify the integration.sap.pr.sync_mode and vendor.documents.required tenant gates
Cause a vendor master change in the external SAP MDG system
Observe that the SAP MDG integration runs for the vendor-change trigger
Compare vendor name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category between Procol and SAP MDG
Verify that no integration error was recorded
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure or verify SAP MDG integration INT-001 and its OAuth, endpoint, client_id, sync_mode, and batch_size settings; Configure or verify the integration.sap.pr.sync_mode and vendor.documents.required tenant gates; Cause a vendor master change in the external SAP MDG system; Observe that the SAP MDG integration runs for the vendor-change trigger; Compare vendor name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category between Procol and SAP MDG; Verify that no integration error was recorded

args.need: configure the SAP MDG integration and required tenant gates, cause a vendor master change in SAP MDG, verify the sync runs, compare name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category in both systems, and confirm no integration error was recorded

steps.note: The entire subject depends on an external SAP MDG system and tenant integration settings that no catalog step can access or observe.
Check that the current Procol screen has no visible crash or server error after the tester completes the external validation; this does not verify the SAP synchronization itself.
